name: koya_pose
desc: Same character, same size, same three-quarter view facing left. New pose: he raises his near hand and pushes his long bangs up and back with his fingers, flicking off drops of paint, the other arm relaxed at his side, a sly sideways glance with the same closed-mouth smirk, standing with both feet planted, a cool confident pose. Keep the exact same head, face, body, colors, cream pattern, outline and pixel art style; change only the arms and hands.
